items.title: Packaging Innovation
items.lead: Four compliant alternatives to a category-standard bulk pail, delivering up to 10% savings
items.detail:
A certain bulk SKU pack (a pail) had become the de facto standard for all brands across the automotive HCV category, leading to commoditisation of the product.
A new regulation made the current pack hard to keep compliant without a significant cost increase. This project explored alternative packaging formats, where cost savings and user-friendliness were the highest priority.
items.caption: Four options that met the new regulatory requirement and also solved trade and consumer challenges, delivering up to 10% savings.

items.title: Kraft Maximisation
items.lead: Harmonised secondary packaging for a cosmetics company, saving more than ₹10 Cr
items.detail:
The client is a large company in the cosmetics world in India. They have their own brands and also distribute other brands through their stores.
Many SKUs had no proper secondary packaging or specifications, and there were damages in the supply chain. Their requirement was to harmonise and set specifications for their secondary packaging.
items.caption: Cost savings of more than ₹10 Cr, and significantly reduced wastage in the system.

items.title: Enhanced Efficiency
items.lead: Reducing downtime and losses on sugar filling lines, and branding a premium range
items.detail:
The client was looking to engage with us for operational excellence.
To reduce downtime of sugar filling lines: an overall assessment of the plant, opportunity areas in material, quality, machinability and loss reduction, and GMP improvement.
Branding of a premium sugar stand-up pouch range.
items.caption: Final reports approved by the top management team for implementation.

items.title: Expert Recommendation
items.lead: An all-India, factory-to-shelf audit to de-risk the move to more sustainable packaging
items.detail:
An all-India audit of the packaging of one of the leading bathing bar brands, from factory to store shelf, to evaluate the wear and tear from origin to consumer.
Use the in-depth learnings to evaluate moving these popular brands to more sustainable solutions.
items.caption:
Audit report with insights and analysis explained via graphs.
Detailed supply chain transit study from factory to shelf, in urban and rural settings.
Expert recommendation report for packaging changeover for market leaders.

items.title: Project Management
items.lead: Commissioning existing packaging at a new production site, on time and to full quality standards
items.detail:
The client is a large FMCG company in the EU and USA, shifting its production base for cost advantages.
They needed packaging project management support, with end-to-end commissioning of the existing packaging at a new site.
items.caption: On track to manufacture the product at the new manufacturing site within the network timelines, meeting full quality standards.

items.title: Vendor Selection & Qualification
items.lead: Finding, qualifying and commissioning a high-quality ISBM mould supplier for a moulder in Egypt
items.detail:
The client had a large moulding unit in Egypt, specialising in ISBM technology.
They sought support to find a suitable high-quality supplier at a competitive price, with an assured timeline.
items.caption: A complete working mould with validated components, commissioned at the client's end.

items.title: Boots-on-the-Ground Support in the Factory
items.lead: On-the-ground support at a third-party manufacturer to secure launch supplies and quality
items.detail:
The client needed on-ground support to understand the full picture at the third party, to ensure they met the launch timelines and quality requirements.
It is a large FMCG company in the EU and USA, shifting its production base for cost advantages.
items.caption: Ensured supplies met the timelines and quality standards.

items.title: On-Site Support to Manage Peaks
items.lead: Placing and mentoring an on-site packaging expert to cover a peak in workload
items.detail:
The client is a large alco-beverage company in India.
They needed an on-site expert to support them temporarily on a few projects, as part of their existing team.
items.caption: An apt expert resource to meet the client's peak requirements.

items.title: Design Optimisation & Print Support
items.lead: Fewer print colours, lower costs and more vendor choice, with no loss of brand impact
items.detail:
The client is a large FMCG company in the space of ayurvedic cosmetics, whose artworks had excessive colours.
A reduced, optimised number of colours resulted in lower costs and an increased choice of compatible vendors with older printing machines.
items.caption: A full process sheet to ensure they can scale it at the printing station with the vendors, with reduced colours and no loss of brand impact.

items.title: Business Expansion
items.lead: A techno-commercial business case for a family-run packaging business diversifying into lug caps
items.detail:
The client had been in the packaging industry for more than 40 years and was looking to diversify into manufacturing lug caps.
The project was to prepare a business case researching the market, to help them identify whether it was worth entering.
items.caption: A complete techno-commercial report that helped the family-run business take an investment decision.
